set.body:
Source: 2026-08-03 quality review, verified against current source.

Problem:
SlurmParsers.outcome (modules/cli/.../SlurmParsers.scala:383) reads

  case SlurmState.Completed if exit.forall(_.code == 0) => Some(WorkloadOutcome.Completed(0))

`Option.forall` is true on None, so a COMPLETED row that reports no exit code at all yields Completed(0). That claims a specific observed exit status the scheduler never disclosed. Slurm reporting COMPLETED does imply the workload succeeded, so the *outcome* is a sound inference; the *exit code 0* is not, and this library distinguishes evidence from inference everywhere else.

Why this is a decision and not a one-line fix:
Representing "completed, exit code undisclosed" needs either a WorkloadOutcome.Completed case that carries no code, or an Option in the existing case. Either is a public shape change, so it belongs in the same window as the other shape work rather than as an isolated Phase A edit.

Interaction:
This is the case P6f.12 already flags for revisit under the deferred P6f.32 decision: once codecs are owned by hand, AccountingBatch can carry a row whose fields are partially undisclosed, which is the same representational problem. Decide both together or the second one reopens the first.

Acceptance:
- A COMPLETED row with an absent exit code does not report a numeric exit status the site never sent.
- A COMPLETED row with an explicit 0:0 still reports Completed(0), pinned by a fixture, so the two cases are distinguishable by a consumer.
- The chosen representation is applied consistently to the sacct and the scontrol paths.
set.title: P8.A11: Stop inferring exit code 0 from an undisclosed COMPLETED exit
